llm_generation.text:
# First-Line Tests for Sarcoidosis Management

## To Confirm Diagnosis / Assess Extent

**Imaging**
- **Chest X-ray** – staging (I–IV) based on hilar adenopathy and parenchymal infiltration
- **High-resolution CT chest** – if CXR equivocal or to assess fibrosis

**Tissue Diagnosis**
- **Biopsy** of most accessible affected site (skin lesion, peripheral lymph node, conjunctival nodule) or via **bronchoscopy with transbronchial lung biopsy/EBUS-TBNA** of mediastinal nodes – looking for non-caseating granulomas
- Always exclude alternative causes of granuloma (TB, fungal, berylliosis, malignancy)

## Baseline Bloods

- **FBC** – anemia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia (marrow involvement)
- **U&E, creatinine** – renal involvement, nephrocalcinosis
- **Liver function tests** – hepatic involvement
- **Serum calcium** – hypercalcemia (from macrophage 1-alpha-hydroxylase activity → increased calcitriol)
- **24-hour urinary calcium** – hypercalciuria
- **Serum ACE** – supportive marker (not diagnostic; sensitivity ~60%, useful for monitoring disease activity/response to treatment in individual patients)
- **Vitamin D levels** (1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D may be elevated)

## Organ-Specific Screening (essential first-line, even if asymptomatic)

- **ECG** – to screen for cardiac involvement (conduction defects, arrhythmias); if abnormal or symptoms present → cardiac MRI/PET
- **Pulmonary function tests (spirometry + gas transfer/DLCO)** – baseline lung function, monitor progression
- **Ophthalmological examination (slit-lamp)** – uveitis, even if asymptomatic, as ocular sarcoid can be silent

## Tuberculin Skin Test / IGRA
- To exclude TB as differential, particularly before starting immunosuppression (also baseline before biologics if considered later)

## Additional Considerations
- **Serum immunoglobulins** – polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia is common
- **Urinalysis** – for renal involvement

---

### Summary Table

| Category | Test |
|---|---|
| Imaging | CXR ± HRCT |
| Tissue | Biopsy (non-caseating granulomas) |
| Bloods | FBC, U&E, LFTs, calcium, ACE |
| Urine | 24h calcium, urinalysis |
| Cardiac | ECG |
| Respiratory | Spirometry + DLCO |
| Ocular | Slit-lamp exam |
| Infection screen | TB test (IGRA/Mantoux) |
